turns.query: 统计 2025 年第一季度华北地区的销售总额
turns.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.region_name='华北' AND o.date_id BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250331'
SELECT SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND o.date_id BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250331'

turns.query: 改成按月份统计，按月份升序
turns.reference_sql: SELECT d.month, SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id=d.date_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1' GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY d.month
